ussd.pinMismatch: PINs did not match. Dial again to restart.
ussd.joined: You have joined. Card number {0}. See your ward agent to be confirmed.
ussd.paid: Dues of {0}{1} received. Thank you. An SMS confirms.
sms.welcome: Welcome to the party. Your card number is {0}. Visit your ward agent to be confirmed.
sms.recordIncomplete: Your party record is incomplete. Missing: {0}. Dial the party code and choose 4, or see your ward agent.
sms.recordIncompleteDated: Your party record is incomplete. Missing: {0}. Complete it by {1} to be on the register for the next contest. Dial the party code and choose 4, or see your ward agent.
sms.recordPartial: Thank you. Still missing: {0}. See your ward agent for anything you cannot enter by phone.
sms.recordComplete: Thank you. Your party record is now complete.

ussd.record.none: Your record is complete. Thank you.
ussd.record.agent: Still needed from your ward agent: {0}.
ussd.record.done: Thank you. Your record is updated.
sms.candidateListed: You are a candidate for {0}. Your name is public. Good luck.
sms.candidateFee: You have registered to compete for {0}. Pay the form fee of {1}{2} to be listed on the ballot. Dial the party code and choose 5.
sms.voteCounted: Your vote was counted. Receipt {0}. You can change it until voting closes.
ussd.vote.closed: No contest is open for voting.
ussd.vote.notEligible: You are not on the register for this contest, so you cannot vote.
ussd.vote.noBallot: There are no candidates to vote for yet.
ussd.vote.cancelled: Cancelled. Your vote was not changed.
ussd.vote.done: Vote counted. Receipt {0}. Dial again to change it before voting closes.
sms.active: You are now an active member. Your card is valid.
